facts.name: Revvity
sentences: Revvity's shares moved 5% or more on 15 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 30 October 2026, when the stock fell 5.3%.
The stock is up 56.7% this year, and at $151.60 it sits 8.6% below its 52-week closing high of $165.78 from 29 October 2026.
$1,000 invested in Revvity five years ago would be worth $860 today.
